basic_info.description: This light-filled 2-bedroom, 2-bath condo sits in a boutique building surrounded by San Francisco's most iconic neighborhoods. The spacious living and dining area features a cozy fireplace and opens to a private terraceperfect for indoor-outdoor living.  Enjoy a beautifully updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances and Carrera quartz countertops, a serene primary suite with verdant views and en suite bath, plus a second well-sized bedroom and full bath.  Additional highlights include one-car parking, private storage, elevator access, and a landscaped shared courtyard. Just steps from Buena Vista Park, the Panhandle, and Duboce Park, with easy access to Muni lines and vibrant shops, cafes, and restaurants in every direction.
